messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — planning a canary rollout of runtime v2.3 this Thu 21:00 UTC. EU-only. Plan: 5% -> 10% -> 25% in 10m steps. Need smoke leads and rollback watchers. Who can own smoke?
ryan: 👍 what's the exact cohort selection? EU regions? any mobile vs web split?
maya: Cohorts are geo buckets: EU-west-1 and EU-central-1, both traffic classes (web/mobile). Basic plan below:
```json
{"percent_steps":[5,10,25],"step_duration_min":10,"cohorts":["eu-west-1","eu-central-1"],"monitoring":["latency_p95","error_rate","token_throughput"]}
```
ryan: ok, will watch latency dashboards. I'll be available during the ramp.
tess: I can own smoke for eu-west-1 — will run the post-deploy smoke script and sanity checks. @sam can you take eu-central-1? :white_check_mark:
sam: on it. i'll run smoke scripts, validate top-50 prompts, and check model quality diffs. quick checklist I'll use:
- run `scripts/smoke/run_smoke.sh --cohort eu-central-1`
- validate `logs/serving/errors` for >0 spikes
- check p95 latency vs baseline on grafana
- confirm rolling back command `./ops/rollouts/rollback --id $ROLLID`
sam: runbook: https://interna.redwood/rollouts/runbooks/canary (copy pinned configs)
deploy-bot: Scheduled: canary rollout v2.3 at 21:00 UTC. ETA 45m. Notifying on-call.
maya: Thanks — please post smoke results in this thread. If any cohort exceeds 2x baseline error_rate or p95 > +200ms, abort and rollback.
ryan: noted. I'll have alert hooks open and can flip traffic back if needed.
tess: Will post `SMOKE OK` or `SMOKE FAIL` with logs. Tagging paging list: @oncall-eng :rotating_light:
maya: final note — keep client-side feature gate off until after 25% succeeds. We'll enable next day for gradual expand. :rocket:
